caption: The model wears a strapless, short, sequined dress with a vibrant, abstract pattern in shades of blue, gold, and black. The dress features a fitted bodice with a sweetheart neckline and a flared skirt that ends at mid-thigh, creating a pencil hem. The dress is paired with high-heeled sandals that have thin straps around the ankles.

The model wears a black, textured, long-sleeved crop top adorned with colorful floral embroidery. The top features a square neckline and a ruffled hem at the bottom. Beneath the top, the model has on a matching black skirt with a similar floral embroidery design, extending to mid-calf length. The skirt has a straight hem and a ruffled edge at the bottom. The model also wears sheer, blue rain boots that reach just above the ankles.

The model wears a white, cropped T-shirt with a graphic design featuring the number "5" in bold, surrounded by a pink and yellow gradient. The T-shirt has a relaxed fit with short, loose sleeves and a crew neck. Over the T-shirt, the model has on a pair of black, textured shorts with a high waist and a drawstring. The shorts have a straight leg cut and are adorned with a pink and purple trim along the bottom hem.
The model wears a plaid, strapless dress that is long, wide, and features a slit on the side. The dress is made of a textured fabric with a mix of black, white, and blue patterns.

The model wears a navy blue and white striped wholebody garment, specifically a long, wide blazer with a peplum waistline that extends past the upper thigh. The blazer features long, loose, straight sleeves and a V-neck with a lace-up detail at the chest. Beneath the blazer, the model has on a short, wide pair of matching navy blue and white striped trousers with flared legs that extend to mid-calf.

The model wears a dark green, puffy wholebody garment, specifically a long, wide puffer jacket that extends past the upper thigh. It features long, loose, straight sleeves and a normal hood. Beneath the jacket, the model has on a long, wide pair of dark green and black plaid trousers as the lower garment, and a short, normal dark green T-shirt as the upper garment.

The model wears a black and white polka dot wholebody garment, specifically a long, loose, sleeveless dress that extends to the ankles. The dress features a deep V-neckline and a fitted waist accentuated by a black belt.

The model wears a navy blue, sleeveless, V-neck top that fits snugly around the torso. The top is made of a soft, stretchy fabric and extends to the waist. Beneath the top, the model has on a pair of light gray, cropped sweatpants with a drawstring waistband. The sweatpants have a relaxed fit and end just above the ankles, creating a casual and comfortable look.
